true_deadlines.description: In-person appointment for residence permit renewal

true_required_actions: Bring passport, biometric photo, proof of health insurance, proof of enrollment
notes: Missing the appointment without rescheduling before the current permit expires ends lawful residence.

true_deadlines.description: Same appointment as A1 — final reminder

true_required_actions: Bring the documents listed in the original letter (A1)
notes: Same underlying deadline as A1, sent as a follow-up. Tests whether extraction correctly ties this back to one case rather than treating it as a new, separate deadline.

Purely informational form letter about general processing delays. No deadline and no action despite official/urgent-sounding letterhead — tests false-positive risk (model inventing an action where none exists).

true_deadlines.description: Submit proof of health insurance for the current semester

true_required_actions: Mail or hand-deliver current health insurance proof to the Ausländerbehörde service office
notes: Clusters with C2 and D4 (same underlying document, three different authorities, similar week) — intentional for Day 5 conflict/priority testing.

true_deadlines.description: Pay income tax balance due (412.00 EUR) for tax year 2025

true_required_actions: Transfer 412.00 EUR to the account named in the assessment
notes: Late payment triggers statutory surcharges (§240 AO) but does not itself risk any status (visa, enrollment, insurance).
Refund notice for a prior tax year (2024) — no deadline, no action. Deliberately similar surface language to B1 to test the model doesn't confuse a refund with a payment demand.

true_deadlines.description: Deadline to file a formal appeal (Einspruch) if disputing the assessment

true_required_actions: File a written appeal only if the recipient disagrees with the assessment
notes: Conditional action — the deadline is real, but the action only applies if the recipient disagrees. Good test case for self-check nuance versus a flat 'must act' deadline.

true_deadlines.description: Submit bank interest statement and proof of tuition payments

true_required_actions: Provide bank interest certificate and tuition payment proof
notes: Missing this deadline leads to an estimated assessment (§162 AO), which can be financially worse than the real figures — real but not existential stakes.
Routine contribution-rate change notice. No deadline, no action.

true_deadlines.description: Submit proof of enrollment for the 2026/2027 winter semester

true_required_actions: Submit current enrollment certificate to the health insurer
notes: Missing this deadline ends student-rate coverage and triggers reclassification into a standard (much more expensive) tariff — real coverage risk.
Approval confirmation. No deadline, no action.

true_deadlines.description: Pay overdue contribution (58.30 EUR) before it is referred to collections

notes: Earliest deadline in the dataset. Small amount but real consequence (collections referral, added costs).

true_deadlines.description: Pay semester fee (315.64 EUR) to re-enroll for winter semester 2026/2027

true_required_actions: Transfer the semester fee with the student ID number referenced
notes: Missing this deadline results in de-registration (Exmatrikulation) — one of the highest-consequence letters in the set.

true_deadlines.description: Register thesis with the examination office

true_required_actions: Submit completed registration form with first supervisor's written approval
notes: Missing it delays graduation timeline rather than ending enrollment outright.
Administrative notice about office hours. No deadline, no action.

true_deadlines.description: Submit statutory health insurance proof to complete enrollment

true_required_actions: Submit health insurance proof to the student registrar
notes: Clusters with A4 and C2 — same underlying document (health insurance proof) required by three different authorities within roughly the same week. Deliberately built this way to give Day 5's conflict engine a real 'same document, multiple deadlines' case to detect.
